messages:
Priya: Quick sync: following the PM review, we're consolidating outstanding remediation tasks across cloud provider flakiness, model-registry auth gaps, and external auth token rate limits. Wanted to list owners and a minimal verification plan so these don't linger.
Maya: thanks. was there a specific recurrence metric you used to flag this?
Priya: yes 14d rolling: 3 incidents with common fingerprint: auth rate-limits (external) -> model-registry 401/429 cascades -> regional sticky routing failing to steer.
Liam: baseline ask: provider SLA details + throttling windows. I can own vendor comms.
Arjun: I can own the client/runtime changes (retry/backoff + split handling).
Tess: I'll own routing + canary policy. Keiko from infra will help with synthetic tests.
Keiko: noted. I'll add failure-injection job to run once/day in staging that simulates 429 bursts and measures queue depth and tail latency.
sre-oncall-bot: Created follow-up incident INC-2026-03-12-422. Reminder: owners checkin in 72h.
Priya: Proposed short actions (lean format):
- A1: Arjun -> model-registry client: implement jittered exp backoff, treat 429 as transient with longer backoff, 401 -> immediate token refresh path. Deliverable: PR + integration test. ETA: 4 business days.
- A2: Liam -> Vendor SLA/support: open case to request maintenance windows and rate-limit docs, negotiate priority contact. Deliverable: SR + summary. ETA: 10 business days.
- A3: Liam -> local token cache: prototype with grace TTL 60s and refresh-on-401. Deliverable: config + feature flag. ETA: 2 weeks.
- A4: Tess -> routing failover: reduce sticky-routing TTL to 20s for model-registry flows, add explicit fallback to alternate region when auth errors observed. Deliverable: canary plan + rollout. ETA: 1 week.
- A5: Keiko -> synthetic test infra: add 429 injection + alert rule for retry storms/queue depth. Deliverable: job + alert. ETA: 5 business days.
- A6: Priya -> dashboard + recurring trend card: add event cluster widget for auth-related cascades and link to postmortem. Deliverable: dashboard update. ETA: EOD next Tue.
Maya: add one ops note: ensure metric includes token refresh failure ratio (401 after refresh) so we catch broken rotation.
Arjun: quick pseudo for backoff I'll use:```
// client backoff (pseudo)
base = 200ms
attempt++
if status == 429 {
  wait = (base * 2^attempt) + rand(0, base) + 1000ms // favor longer backoff for 429
} else {
  wait = (base * 2^attempt) + rand(0, base)
}
// if 401 -> trigger immediate refresh + single retry
```
Tess: about the TTL change: we'll run 10% canary for 48h and measure cold-start token misses. If P95 latency increases > 10% we roll back.
Keiko: synthetic job will emit a PASS/FAIL and an SLO drift signal to the incidents alert channel so we can validate before rollout.
Liam: FYI I already queued a provider case: SR-64522, asked for historical rate-limit windows and any planned infra upgrades.
Priya: Good. Let's keep the thread minimal and track progress in the postmortem follow-up doc. I'll create follow-up tickets and link them to INC-2026-03-12-422.
Maya: can we have a 30m sync in 72h to review PRs and vendor reply?
Priya: @deploy-bot please schedule 72h check-in.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Dependency Mitigation Check-in" 1 Mar 15 09:30am PT. Invite: Priya, Maya, Liam, Arjun, Tess, Keiko.
sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: A1 due in 4 business days.
Arjun: I'll post PR link in the doc when ready.
Liam: will paste SR updates as soon as vendor responds.
Keiko: will post synthetic job runbook and alert thresholds to the doc.
Priya: Closing thread for updates; please update the follow-up doc and tickets rather than posting here. We'll use the 72h meeting for status. Thanks. :thumbsup:
